reviewer: Codex; same author, separate review pass
method: Inspect schemas, immutable identities, transport outcomes, request-bound probes, credential fields, profile resolution, fixture isolation, historical proof snapshots, canonical path order and native-report graph transfer; inspect fresh negative-case and success reports.
limitations: Native Windows execution is NOT_RUN; no P01 acceptance.
Static type check and visual rendering are NOT_RUN.
No live provider, durable storage or Council runtime has been tested.

findings.reason: Probe cannot rebind an attempt to another connection.
Probe cannot rebind an attempt to another frozen input.
DeliveryObservation carries the frozen request hash.
Resolved profile paths cannot enter the source tree.
Synthetic fixtures reset acceptance and preservation references independently of real progress.
Accepted criterion bytes and original review survive later source/report changes.
Canonical textual path order is independent of native Windows case-fold ordering.
Native report graphs are preserved without changing source allowlist for each generated run ID.
Empty multiline env templates are accepted while recognizable nonempty credentials remain refused.
Capture the complete subprocess log before writing and binding immutable native evidence; validate every stored artifact before publishing the report.
